title: A Clinic at the Entrance to Heliópolis, and One That Had to Close
conflicts: First clinic: most sources say Heliópolis (opened August 2011); a 2017 brandchannel interview says São Mateus; Veja SP (2014) says both opened in 2011 and the São Mateus trial closed after nine months, while Portuguese Wikipedia says it closed in 2011. Story leads with Heliópolis and attributes the São Mateus closure to Veja. Start-up money: R$1 million in fit-out (Saúde Business) vs about R$3 million over three years implied by Veja; used the narrower, earlier figure.
notes: Srougi's remarks exist only in Portuguese, so they are paraphrased, not quoted. Funding changed from slate 'venture' to 'mixed': founders' and partners' money for the first three years, venture funds (Kaszek, LGTVP) from 2014. Wikipedia (pt) cited once as supplementary.
